title: Reinstatement of Lapsed Wanderlane Traveller Club Points
content:
Lapsed Wanderlane Traveller Club points are reinstated only when the moment the request is handled is not after the moment the expiry sweep removed the points from the member's card plus the reinstatement window of the tier held. The moment the sweep removed the points is taken from the card's own record of that sweep, and not from the date the member noticed the points were gone or the date they first wrote in.

The reinstatement window is counted in whole calendar days from the day of the sweep, weekends and public holidays included, and a request made exactly on the closing day is still in time. Reinstatement carries the reinstatement fee of the tier held at the time of the request, and a tier whose fee is zero reinstates free of charge.

## Where the window closes

The count starts from the day of the sweep and runs the number of calendar days the tier's window carries. No day is skipped along the way: weekends and public holidays are counted like any other day. The closing day is the last day on which a request is in time, and a request made exactly on that day is still in time.

## Both sides of the boundary

Take a tier whose reinstatement window is 60 calendar days, a figure chosen here for the illustration.

- A request handled on the sixtieth calendar day after the day of the sweep falls exactly on the closing day. It is not after the sweep plus the window, and it is in time.
- A request handled on the sixty-first calendar day after the day of the sweep falls after the closing day. It is after the sweep plus the window, and it is out of time.
- A request handled on the thirtieth calendar day is comfortably inside the window, and the two days of that weekend it spanned are counted in the thirty like any other days.

A window of 0 calendar days closes on the day of the sweep itself.

## The fee is read at the time of the request

The fee charged is the reinstatement fee of the tier held at the time of the request. Where the member held a different tier on the day the points were swept, that earlier tier's fee is not the fee charged; the tier held when the request is made settles it. Where the fee of that tier is zero, the reinstatement is made free of charge.
